name: legacy_endpoint
description: Historical one-line interpretation: a client-side SMB signing flag is treated as a machine-wide 'enabled' result.

assumptions.scope: The LanmanWorkstation Parameters key describes SMB signing for the whole host.
assumptions.sufficiency: EnableSecuritySignature=1 is sufficient to call SMB signing enabled.

rules.subject: smb_signing
rules.description: Workstation EnableSecuritySignature=1 is reported as 'SMB signing enabled'.
